outcome: Serum lactate levels after 72 hours of therapeutic hypothermia
cohort: 17 newborn infants with hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), gestational age > 35 weeks and birth weight ≥ 1800 g, admitted to Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (CGMH) between April 2011 and December 2012
finding: Higher serum lactate levels following therapeutic hypothermia and abnormal brain MRI findings were associated with poor neurodevelopmental outcome in infants with HIE.
